subtitle: 房間發霉影響健康，寫信向住宿組申請換房
task: You live in a university dormitory, but your room has a mold problem that is making your asthma worse. Write an email to the Housing Office. Describe the problem, explain how it affects you, and request a transfer to another room.
taskZh: 你住在學校宿舍，但房間的發霉問題讓你的氣喘變嚴重。寫一封 email 給住宿服務組：描述問題、說明對你的影響，並申請換到別的房間。
focus: 具體描述問題與已採取的處理
說明對健康的影響並附上證明
提出明確的請求與可配合的時間

en: My name is Tina Hsu, and I live in Room 112 of Maple Hall. I am writing to request a transfer to another room because of a mold problem that is affecting my health.

Since the rainy season started in October, dark spots of mold have appeared on the wall behind my bed and around the window. Even though I clean them every week with the spray the maintenance staff gave me, they come back within a few days. I have asthma, and I have needed my inhaler much more often this month. My doctor believes the damp air in my room is the main cause.
I have attached photos of the wall and a note from my doctor. I would be happy to move to any room on a higher floor, and I can move this weekend if a space is available.
Thank you for your help. I look forward to your reply.
zh: 我是徐婷娜，住在楓林宿舍 112 號房。由於房間的發霉問題影響到我的健康，我寫信想申請換房。
自從十月雨季開始，我床後方的牆壁和窗戶周圍就出現了黑色的霉斑。雖然我每週都用維修人員給的噴劑清理，但霉斑幾天內又會長回來。我有氣喘，這個月需要使用吸入器的次數多了很多。醫生認為我房間潮濕的空氣是主要原因。
我已附上牆壁的照片和醫生證明。我很樂意搬到任何較高樓層的房間，如果有空房，我這個週末就可以搬。
謝謝您的協助。期待您的回覆。
